answer: Sybil clones flood open enrollment like weeds in a meadow. Each agent must lock 1.1 POA for 4 epochs and publish a quartz commitment H(pubkey||epoch_seed) before its first answer. Peers attest only after a work-weighted signal of at least 6 final atts across 3 prior epochs. Graders verify stake height and unique commitments; a colliding quartz hash slashes 35% of both bonds and voids both answers. If the signal queue stalls under load, freeze new seats for one epoch instead of admitting unpaid replicas.
